scope.implemented: Ordinary F16_V2, BF16_V2, E8M7_V2, and E6M9_V2 HMNMX2 classes with materializable R/UR/immediate/ordinary constant-bank operands where present on SM75-SM120. E8M7_V2 aliases BF16_V2. Supports min/max polarity, lane swizzles, source abs/neg, F16 FTZ, NAN canonicalization, and format-specific XORSIGN. RRR/RUR/RCR XORSIGN requires both explicit absolute flags; RIR XORSIGN uses its encoded Ra absolute flag and retains the immediate sign. With one NaN and default NaN handling, the selected non-NaN value receives the XOR of raw source signs; .NAN and two-NaN cases remain canonical 0x7fff. E6M9 comparisons use encoded integer ordering; its NaNs canonicalize to 0x7fff and it has no FTZ selector.
scope.nan: SM89 GPU returns canonical 0x7fff per affected lane for the NAN selector in F16_V2, BF16_V2, and E6M9_V2; two NaNs also canonicalize for all three.
scope.xorsign: SM89 GPU confirms magnitude comparison and raw source-sign XOR in destination for F16_V2, BF16_V2, and E6M9_V2, including one-NaN/default-NaN behavior; .NAN and two-NaN results remain canonical.
scope.fallbacks: The native SM90+ IS_A implementation has emulator/dataflow evidence but remains hardware-unverified. SM89 RCxR CX forms were verified across the MD-valid format, min/max, FTZ, NAN, and XORSIGN selector combinations; alternate swizzles and direct C-bank hardware forms remain unverified.

scope.reference: PTX documents E2M1 as a finite 4-bit format and specifies conversion from packed e2m1x2 to f16x2, with the upper nibble mapped to the upper F16 lane and lower nibble to the lower F16 lane. E0M3 uses the independent sign-magnitude mapping documented at https://github.com/revollllt/sm120-e0m3-mma; this is format evidence, not SM100 F2FP hardware validation.

scope.implemented: F16/BF16 to E2M1 and E0M3x4 for SM100/SM101/SM103/SM120 RIR/RRI/RRR/RRU/RUR forms; RN-even, SATFINITE, and optional RELU.
scope.packing: B supplies Rd[7:0], C supplies Rd[15:8]. Each packed F16/BF16 pair converts low half to low nibble and high half to high nibble.
scope.reference: CUDA cuda_fp4.hpp specifies nearest-even conversion, signed maxnorm saturation, and NaN to positive maxnorm. The ptxas lowering emits F2FP.SATFINITE.E2M1.F16.UNPACK_B_MERGE_C for the PTX conversion; the generated low-byte result is masked with 0xff. E0M3 uses the sign-plus-3-bit-magnitude integer grid documented at https://github.com/revollllt/sm120-e0m3-mma; RN-even thresholds are derived from that grid. NaNs canonicalize to positive 7 before RELU. This is format-derived semantics, not hardware validation.
scope.fallbacks: F32-to-4-bit and other format/merge/rounding families remain opaque. No SM100+ device is available for hardware execution.

scope.implemented: Scaled E2M1/E0M3 to BF16x2 for SM100/SM101/SM103/SM120 RIR/RRI/RRR/RRU/RUR forms. B0-B3 select one source byte; its low/high nibbles map to low/high BF16 lanes and use the corresponding low/high UE8M0 bytes from the second source. RN, SATFINITE, and optional RELU are supported.
scope.reference: PTX specifies E2M1 nibble conversion followed by multiplication by the per-lane UE8M0 scale factor. E0M3 extends this formula using its sign-plus-3-bit-magnitude integer grid; this extension is format-derived rather than directly documented by PTX.
scope.numeric: UE8M0 byte 0 represents 2^-127, bytes 1..254 represent 2^(byte-127), and 0xff produces canonical NaN. The exact product is rounded to BF16 with RN-even; SATFINITE clamps overflow to signed max finite, and RELU maps negative non-NaN results to +0.
scope.hardware_scope: No compatible SM100+ GPU is available. The available SM89 GPU cannot execute the target encodings; results are emulator-verified, not hardware-measured.

scope.implemented: E5M2, E4M3, E2M3, E3M2, E3M4, and signed S2_6 source bytes to BF16x2 on SM100/SM101/SM103/SM120 for RIR/RRI/RRR/RRU/RUR, H0/H1, RN, optional RELU, and optional SATFINITE.
scope.reference: PTX specifies conversion to BF16 followed by multiplication by the matching UE8M0 scale byte; H0/H1 select the source and scale pairs, and omitted PTX scale defaults to 0x7f7f. S2F6 is signed 8-bit two's-complement times 2^-6. E3M4 follows the independent format reference. UE8M0 uses 0x00=2^-127, 1..254=2^(byte-127), and 0xff=NaN.
scope.coverage_note: Each lane sweeps all 256 source bytes and all 256 scale bytes in paired permutations; the matrix does not cover the full source-byte by scale-byte Cartesian product.

scope.packing: A and B convert to the high and low nibbles of Rd[7:0], respectively. C supplies Rd[31:8]. The PTX lowering establishes the E2M1 low-byte conversion and source order; the C merge follows the PACK_AB_MERGE_C behavior used by the F32-to-FP8 emitter and is emulator-tested, not hardware-confirmed for this class.
scope.reference: E2M1 conversion uses the documented E2M1 values and nearest-even midpoint rules; infinities and finite overflow clamp to signed maxnorm and NaNs canonicalize to positive maxnorm. E0M3 uses signed integer magnitudes 0..7 with nearest-even rounding, saturation, and the same NaN/RELU convention. PTX directly documents E2M1; E0M3 is format-derived.
